summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting minutes of a Board of Directors meeting held July 10, 2026, where Mr. Alessandro de Castro Melo was unanimously elected as Chief Engineering, Technology and Innovation Officer to complete a term expiring at the first Board meeting after the 2028 Annual Shareholders Meeting. The appointment followed a favorable recommendation from the People and Organization Committee. The filing is the election of a statutory officer—an executive management change—not a routine meeting notice or proxy circular. No financial terms, premiums, or deal mechanics are involved. Watch for any future strategic shifts or related personnel moves.
